title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 7: Liberalism
premise: While expanding Franklin, donoteat01 argues that liberal promises of freedom coexist with property protection, labor exploitation, and exclusion, and that neoliberalism revives these mechanisms. A prison-strike solidarity statement opens the episode; historical and political claims are his account.
coverage: Prison-strike solidarity precedes Franklin's expansion and an argument about liberalism, property, labor, and excluded rights. Political portraits, Minecraft wages, and a city tour accompany the presenter's historical interpretation.

panels.heading: Prison-strike prologue
panels.description: DNE token on black holds the screen while the presenter announces the national prison strike.
panels.action: Static holding graphic.

panels.heading: Incarceration comparison
panels.description: Bar chart headed Incarceration rates per 100,000 places the United States first at 707.
panels.action: The chart replaces the token.

panels.heading: Prison-labor mechanism
panels.description: The token returns on black while the presenter describes financial incentives and underpaid labor.
panels.action: Static token.

panels.heading: Super-predator counter-image
panels.description: Hillary Clinton appears in a captioned interview still containing super-predators and No conscience, no empathy.
panels.action: Political quotation image cuts into the token sequence.
panels.visualGag: The presenter rejects the super-predator label as a Clinton image displays it.

panels.heading: Solidarity close
panels.description: DNE token remains centered on black during the strike solidarity statement.
panels.action: Static token.

panels.heading: Franklin opening
panels.description: Orange FRANKLIN and bell icon, A DONOTEAT SERIES, over riverside industrial scenery; later views show a street and overhead waterfront.
panels.camera: The title montage cuts among moving city views; its exact camera path is uncertain.
panels.action: Title graphics overlay ships and buildings.

sound.text: Title music: Beethoven Symphony No. 5, IV. Allegro, performed by the Davis High School Symphony Orchestra, as credited for the title sequence.

panels.heading: Expansion enabled by water
panels.description: EPISODE 7 / LIBERALISM banner sits above road-building and rectangular empty parcels.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.

panels.heading: Liberalism: provocative setup
panels.description: LIBERALISM appears over the evolving city grid.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: Concept label overlays the city.
panels.visualGag: Setup for the following I HATE LIBERALS collage: the bare term invites the US partisan reading before conservative and Democratic politicians are mixed.

panels.heading: I hate liberals: visual reversal
panels.description: Collage combines Reagan, Bush senior, Obama, Bush junior under MISSION ACCOMPLISHED, Thatcher, and Biden, with I HATE LIBERALS.
panels.action: Static collage overlays editor footage.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the previous label: conservatives appear among the hated liberals, making the intentionally misleading partisan slogan anticipate the capital-L definition.

panels.heading: Define the tradition, build the town
panels.description: Rows of small houses and longer brick buildings are added to empty parcels.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.

panels.heading: Locke and the Treatises
panels.description: John Locke portrait and JOHN LOCKE (1632–1704) appear with the Two Treatises title page.
panels.action: Portrait and book-page insert; no figure movement.
panels.visualGag: A straight thinker-and-book setup for the deliberately literal divine-right image that follows.

panels.heading: Divine right rendered literally
panels.description: God from Monty Python and the Holy Grail appears as a crowned bearded face in clouds and a fiery halo over gameplay.
panels.action: Static comic heavenly-face image replaces the book reference.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to Locke's attack on divine right: heavenly authority becomes an absurd literal crowned head in clouds.
panels.notes: God is the cutout from Monty Python and the Holy Grail.

panels.heading: Social contract and property
panels.description: SOCIAL CONTRACT appears over brick buildings and a courtyard; nearby views show paving and additional structures.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.

panels.heading: Smith and Wealth of Nations
panels.description: ADAM SMITH (1723–1790), portrait, and Wealth of Nations title page identify the next thinker.
panels.action: Static portrait/title-page overlays; underlying road layout changes.
panels.visualGag: Sets up the Ayn Rand self-interest photo and the literal invisible hand that follow; the portrait itself is played straight.

panels.heading: Self-interest / Rand
panels.description: Black-and-white photograph of Ayn Rand smiling at a writing desk with RATIONAL SELF-INTEREST.
panels.action: Static photo; then return to city editing.
panels.visualGag: The Ayn Rand photograph anticipates the later Ayn Rand garbage line.

panels.heading: The very visible invisible hand
panels.description: Super Smash Bros. screenshot: Mario faces Master Hand, the huge floating white glove, under THE INVISIBLE HAND, with a 05:00 timer, 0% and 300 H.P.
panels.action: Static Super Smash Bros. screenshot.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the Smith concepts: an invisible, beneficent market mechanism becomes an extremely visible, threatening boss hand.

panels.heading: Market inference / Rand callback
panels.description: Return to city work and selected taller brick buildings.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.
panels.visualGag: The spoken Ayn Rand garbage line pays off the earlier Rand photograph; the giant white glove just before it supplied the visual half of the invisible-hand joke.

panels.heading: Laissez-faire
panels.description: LAISSEZ-FAIRE white on black, followed by city work.
panels.action: Static concept card, then editor work.

sound.text: French mispronunciation gag on laissez-faire, delivered over the LAISSEZ-FAIRE concept card.

panels.heading: A factory owner: setup
panels.description: Editor previews buildings at forested road junction.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.
panels.visualGag: Spoken setup for the Minecraft factory gag, in which the generic factory becomes a tiny block-built workshop.

panels.heading: The factory is Minecraft
panels.description: Wooden Minecraft door marked FACTORY, torches, stone/dirt interior, crafting table.
panels.camera: A hard switch from Cities: Skylines to first-person Minecraft; the view turns from the door to the crafting table.
panels.action: Blocky player hand visible; viewpoint surveys workshop.
panels.visualGag: The factory is a crude block-built workshop with a FACTORY sign.

panels.heading: Means of production
panels.description: MEANS OF PRODUCTION in quotes over Franklin street grid.
panels.action: Text overlay on returned editor.
panels.visualGag: Means of production names the miniature Minecraft workshop equipment before the owner caricature appears.

panels.heading: Capitalist caricature
panels.description: Grinning red-faced top-hatted capitalist caricature overlays gameplay; specific artwork/source is unknown.
panels.action: Static cartoon; later city view.
panels.visualGag: Comic owner reveal within the factory sequence: a conventional greed caricature stands in for an ordinary proprietor.

panels.heading: Work becomes crafting
panels.description: Minecraft crafting/inventory interface follows iron-block targeting and cracking.
panels.camera: Hard return to Minecraft; view tilts toward blocks then opens crafting screen.
panels.action: An iron block cracks and the crafting screen opens; the inventory holds an ingot stack marked 27.
panels.visualGag: Production in the factory sequence sets up the wage punchline, with the labor enacted in literal videogame materials.
panels.notes: The full exchange of materials is not shown.

panels.heading: Goods chest before payday
panels.description: Downward view of open chest beside furnace and another closed chest.
panels.camera: First-person view points down; interface changes from crafting to room.
panels.action: The chest stands open; most hotbar slots are empty.
panels.visualGag: An intermediate step before payday: the goods chest comes just before the DRAW PAY HERE station.
panels.notes: The exact transfer of goods is unclear.

panels.heading: Draw pay here: payoff
panels.description: DRAW PAY HERE hangs above a chest and two hoppers; an ingot later appears in the hotbar.
panels.camera: The view turns toward the pay chest and tilts upward, and the chest interface opens.
panels.action: Chest interaction; ingot appears after earlier empty slot.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the workshop labor: the literal payday station hands over a meager-looking ingot wage, tying together the factory, the work and the withheld surplus.
panels.notes: The crafting inventory earlier held 27 ingots; the wage is an unnumbered ingot icon in the hotbar. The exact pay ratio is uncertain.

panels.heading: Ripped off: conclusion
panels.description: City editing returns to factory yards and road/house expansion.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.
panels.visualGag: The ripped-off conclusion turns the Minecraft work-and-pay sequence into a direct address to the viewer.

panels.heading: Freedom with caveats: spoken turn
panels.description: Plain Franklin editor footage shows housing, yard surfaces, and placement previews while the presenter turns from universal freedom to its exceptions.
panels.camera: Oblique overhead views shift among buildings; the exact camera path is uncertain.
panels.action: City paving and building placement continue; the Carolina document has not yet appeared.
panels.visualGag: Argumentative setup for the rights-asterisk sequence: the spoken freedom promise begins acquiring exclusions before the document and list appear.

panels.heading: Locke contradiction
panels.description: Fundamental Constitutions of CAROLINA page overlays yard work.
panels.action: Static page; underlying surfaces change.
panels.notes: The Carolina page stays on screen only briefly.

panels.heading: The rights asterisk
panels.description: Accumulating list: slaves, indentured servants, women, men without property, men with little property, people who have committed crimes.
panels.camera: The list grows over changing city views.
panels.action: Player adds vegetation while exclusion list expands.
panels.visualGag: The spoken asterisk becomes a visible list of people excluded from the universal promise. A later starred footnote reverses what the asterisk does.

panels.heading: Exclusions produce exploitable labor
panels.description: The printed exclusion list disappears; ordinary editor footage shows tree placement between brick buildings.
panels.camera: Oblique overhead views change framing around nearby housing.
panels.action: The player adds trees and works among housing blocks; no PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY caption is present yet.
panels.visualGag: Conclusion to the rights-asterisk visual sequence: the presenter explains the excluded groups as cheap labor after the exclusion list clears.

panels.heading: Personal responsibility
panels.description: PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY in quotes over street grid.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.

panels.heading: Thatcher: damaged hotel
panels.description: White seaside hotel with collapsed central section replaces gameplay.
panels.action: Static historical photo; no collapse in progress.
panels.visualGag: A wrecked hotel replaces the expected Thatcher portrait, apparently invoking the Brighton bombing.

panels.heading: From Thatcher to neoliberalism
panels.description: After the damaged-hotel insert clears, the city editor returns to empty parcels and nearby developed blocks.
panels.camera: Cut from the historical photograph back to shifting overhead gameplay.
panels.action: Road/grid editing continues before the NEOLIBERALISM label appears.
panels.visualGag: A bridge out of the dark Thatcher hotel aside and into the neoliberal politician inserts; the plain gameplay here carries no new visual pun.

panels.heading: Neoliberal pragmatism
panels.description: NEOLIBERALISM label, then Obama portrait over terrain/street editing.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: Static label/portrait interrupt city work.
panels.visualGag: Sets up the ironic politician portraits: the do-what-works claim is contradicted by the policies listed next.

panels.heading: Saxophone Clinton
panels.description: Clinton sits holding saxophone in room.
panels.action: Static photo; no playing movement.
panels.visualGag: A playful choice of photo that repeats in the presidential list and echoes the opening collage.

panels.heading: Biden / neoliberal definition
panels.description: Raised-hand Biden at microphone; then PRIVATIZATION / ANTI-UNIONISM / PERSONAL RESPONSIBILITY.
panels.action: Static Biden photo; accumulating text over editor.
panels.visualGag: Biden's raised-hand portrait echoes the opening collage as the policy list grows over city editing.

panels.heading: Rollback / bankruptcy foreshadowing
panels.description: Brick buildings extend beside river, then view shifts toward vacant blocks.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.

panels.heading: Two flavors / starred caveat
panels.description: NOT TO DISCOUNT THE IMPORTANCE OF ABORTION AND GAY RIGHTS in large starred text.
panels.action: Static qualification over editing.
panels.visualGag: Calls back to the rights asterisk and reverses it: the earlier asterisk excluded people, while this starred footnote insists these rights matter even as he compares the two electoral flavors.

panels.heading: Reagan: collage payoff
panels.description: Reagan portrait over housing.
panels.action: Static portrait over city editing.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the opening collage: a conservative is explicitly classed under the capital-L economic definition.

panels.heading: Bush senior
panels.description: George H. W. Bush portrait replaces Reagan.
panels.action: Cut between static portraits.
panels.visualGag: The opening-collage payoff continues: party affiliation does not exempt a president.

panels.heading: Clinton saxophone callback
panels.description: Clinton saxophone photo returns.
panels.action: Static seated pose, no playing movement.
panels.visualGag: Calls back to the earlier playful photo and the opening collage; the same label crosses parties.

panels.heading: Mission accomplished
panels.description: Bush junior at shipboard podium beneath MISSION ACCOMPLISHED.
panels.action: Static photo.
panels.visualGag: Calls back to the opening collage, with an ironic achievement banner beside the foreign-war critique.

panels.heading: Obama: same label
panels.description: Arms-folded Obama portrait returns.
panels.action: Static photo.
panels.visualGag: Calls back to the opening collage and the earlier policy inserts: a change of party does not change the label.

panels.heading: Trump exception
panels.description: Trump portrait replaces Obama.
panels.action: Static photo.
panels.visualGag: Trump's portrait accompanies the list-ending twist that his handlers are liberals.

panels.heading: Heroic Bernie
panels.description: Bright cartoon of muscular shirtless bespectacled Sanders near White House, one arm raised and other flexed.
panels.action: Static exaggerated bodybuilder pose.
panels.visualGag: The absurd bodybuilder caricature exaggerates the arrival of an opposition after the parade of neoliberal presidents.
panels.notes: The cartoon's source and corner emblem are uncertain.

panels.heading: DSA convention composite
panels.description: Large rectangular portrait of young Joseph Stalin in a white shirt superimposed above convention crowd.
panels.action: Static composite after brief return to city work.
panels.visualGag: Comic disproportion: the enormous casual portrait dominates the convention scene, continuing the humorous movement images after the muscular Sanders.

panels.heading: Ocasio-Cortez
panels.description: Close Ocasio-Cortez portrait on black.
panels.action: Static campaign-related portrait.

panels.heading: Carter / unfinished work
panels.description: Lee Carter beside CARTER FOR VIRGINIA sign.
panels.action: Static folded-arm campaign photo.

panels.heading: Qualification / support pitch
panels.description: Housing editing continues; wider view reveals river and city grid.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.

panels.heading: Patreon-only setup
panels.description: PATREON-ONLY CONTENT in white on black.
panels.action: Static commercial card.
panels.visualGag: Sets up the permission-to-pirate reversal that follows; the card itself is played straight.

panels.heading: Paywall pitch undercuts itself
panels.description: Housing rows and blue building preview in editor.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.
panels.visualGag: The PATREON-ONLY pitch is undercut by permission to share the videos when unable to pay.

panels.heading: Coffee becomes beer
panels.description: Selected long brick buildings line river.
panels.camera: Oblique and overhead editor views change angle and distance between sites.
panels.action: The player selects buildings and adjusts placement previews and parcel grids.
panels.visualGag: Coffee donations become beer money in a spoken joke over city editing.

panels.heading: UI-free aerial reveal
panels.description: After a black frame, houses, a factory chimney, and docks appear without editor controls; overhead views cross the river and street grid.
panels.camera: The aerial view pulls back and rotates from housing and factories toward the river and grid. Its exact path is uncertain.
panels.action: Completed-city scenery; no more building placement.

sound.text: Cinematic music: Mendelssohn's The Hebrides, performed by the Musopen Symphony, as credited for this sequence.

panels.heading: Retreat along street
panels.description: Low river-facing view between buildings gives way to long tree-lined street and rooftops.
panels.camera: After a cut, the camera retreats inland and rises to reveal the blocks.
panels.action: City tour, not character-led action.

panels.heading: Waterfront sweep
panels.description: Red-brick buildings, docks, ship and factory chimney in UI-free riverfront framing.
panels.camera: A cut, then a sideways waterfront sweep rotating toward the industrial frontage.
panels.action: Water/boats visible; individual resident actions not established.

panels.heading: River / waterworks payoff
panels.description: Courtyard widens over river; basin, embankment, bridge, rocky shore, factory appear.
panels.camera: After a cut, wider views move out over the river and past the waterworks toward the factory. The exact path is uncertain.
panels.action: Finished-city survey recalls water supply enabling expansion.

panels.heading: Patron credits
panels.description: My Patreons and white name column on black.
panels.action: Names scroll; no character action.

panels.heading: Token bookend
panels.description: A black frame, then the DNE token returns.
panels.camera: Static centered token; its final transition is unclear.
panels.action: Token return bookends prologue graphic.

panels.heading: Final black
panels.description: The video ends on black.
panels.action: No visible action.
